title: Code Mixologist : A Practitioner’s Guide to Building Code-Mixed LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the 'Code-Mixing Gap' by comparing downstream task performance on code-mixed inputs versus matched monolingual inputs, and measuring 'language reversion' (the tendency of models to collapse to monolingual English) using structural indices and calibrated LLM-as-a-Judge protocols.

Using benchmarks like ENKOQA to test if models exhibit generic, Westernized hallucinations in English, and whether code-mixed queries can successfully 'activate' dormant localized and cultural knowledge.

Reviewing data collection and annotation pipelines for geographical and social representativeness to identify systematic blind spots regarding non-standard dialects and diverse socio-demographic groups.
